name: doplarr
description: Doplarr(https://github.com/kiranshila/Doplarr) is an *arr request bot for Discord."

variables.name: DISCORD__TOKEN
variables.description: Specify your discord bot token.

variables.name: OVERSEERR__API
variables.description: Specify your Overseerr API key. Leave blank if using Radarr/Sonarr.

variables.name: OVERSEERR__URL
variables.description: Specify your Overseerr URL. Leave blank if using Radarr/Sonarr.

variables.name: RADARR__API
variables.description: Specify your Radarr API key. Leave blank if using Overseerr.

variables.name: RADARR__URL
variables.description: Specify your Radarr URL. Leave blank if using Overseerr.

variables.name: SONARR__API
variables.description: Specify your Sonarr API key. Leave blank if using Overseerr.

variables.name: SONARR__URL
variables.description: Specify your Sonarr URL. Leave blank if using Overseerr.

variables.name: DISCORD__MAX_RESULTS
variables.description: Sets the maximum size of the search results selection

variables.name: DISCORD__REQUESTED_MSG_STYLE
variables.description: Sets the style of the request alert message. One of `:plain` `:embed` `:none`

variables.name: SONARR__QUALITY_PROFILE
variables.description: The name of the quality profile to use by default for Sonarr

variables.name: RADARR__QUALITY_PROFILE
variables.description: The name of the quality profile to use by default for Radarr

variables.name: SONARR__ROOTFOLDER
variables.description: The root folder to use by default for Sonarr

variables.name: RADARR__ROOTFOLDER
variables.description: The root folder to use by default for Radarr

variables.name: SONARR__LANGUAGE_PROFILE
variables.description: The name of the language profile to use by default for Sonarr

variables.name: OVERSEERR__DEFAULT_ID
variables.description: The Overseerr user id to use by default if there is no associated discord account for the requester

variables.name: PARTIAL_SEASONS
variables.description: Sets whether users can request partial seasons.

variables.name: LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: The log level for the logging backend. This can be changed for debugging purposes. One of trace `:debug` `:info` `:warn` `:error` `:fatal` `:report`

variables.name: JAVA_OPTS
variables.description: For passing additional java options.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: Container Variable: PUID

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Container Variable: PGID

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: Container Variable: UMASK
